company.name: Jeevam Health
company.shortDescription: Holistic care app to treat chronic conditions: Thyroid, PCOS, Pregnancy Challenges.
company.description:
Jeevam Health (YC S20) is a holistic care App for thyroid treatment. Even after taking medication, 60% of women are having unresolved symptoms like fatigue, weight issues, and pregnancy challenges. 
App assists the user to identify the underlying cause & implement holistic treatment combining food, supplements, lifestyle & medicine. 

Jeevam Health is backed by Y Combinator, Good Water Capital, Cloud Capital, Dexter Angels

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application designed to support management and treatment of chronic conditions such as Thyroid disorders, PCOS, and pregnancy-related challenges.
productsAndServices.name: Holistic Care App for Chronic Conditions
